title: NEXUS command acknowledgement (contract 1.0 and legacy-v1)
description: Device to NEXUS, published on nexus/devices/<deviceId>/commands/ack. A device claim, never used for latency. status is exactly ACCEPTED or REJECTED (case-sensitive); timestamp is an integer epoch-second; reason is optional.

timestamp.description: Epoch seconds; the bounds are the range of java.time.Instant, outside which the backend handler throws instead of dropping the message.

x-nexus-rules: identity (layer 3): the device id in the topic is checked against the stored command by the core, not by the wire contract
reason vocabulary the shipped devices use: MALFORMED, UNSUPPORTED, STALE (not enforced: the backend stores any text)
